name: Dakota Natural Gas Drayton Pipeline

values.StartLocation: Viking Gas Transmission town border station northwest of Donaldson

researcher_notes: Not in the GEM roster under any name. Existing P3158 Traill County Pipeline is the built line, a different project. P3162 and P3584 North Bakken Expansion is the replacement project, not this line. A Federal Register notice from July 2018 says Dakota Natural Gas filed an application on June 28, 2018 and would build about 17.3 miles of new pipe from a Viking Gas Transmission interconnect northwest of Donaldson, Minnesota, to Drayton, North Dakota (9.3 miles in Minnesota, 1.5 miles to a regulator station, 6.5 miles south to Drayton). The notice gives docket CP18-511. The EIA August 2026 release, Historical Projects sheet row 1149, gives docket CP18-514, 17.3 miles, 2 and 4 inch pipe, cost 3.2 million dollars, status cancelled, last updated October 2019, with the note withdrawn in favor of the North Bakken Expansion Project. The docket numbers differ and should be checked against FERC eLibrary. Length is 27.8 km, above the 25 km threshold. The applicant describes itself as a new local distribution company, so pipeline type could be distribution instead of transmission. Owner is a new entity with no legal form found. EIA is one origin, the Federal Register is a second origin for the length only. No route found. Medium confidence.
